items: cache — Saved result for quicker reuse.

blocks.title: Identify
blocks.text: Specify the inputs and outputs before choosing algorithms: ticket count and unit price determine total charge.

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: Make preconditions explicit. Invalid negatives or overflow can produce incorrect outputs; validation and appropriate types reduce risks.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Caching saves a previously computed result for reuse, trading memory and stale-result risk against repeated calculation time. Reusable methods reduce repeated code.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the decision
blocks.text: The algorithm's result can be correct mathematically but invalid under the declared application rules.
